name: refine-skill-tools
title: Skill Refinery
description: Improve an existing Agent Skill through baseline execution, bounded candidate edits, held-out evaluation, independent comparison, and regression rejection.
notes:
## What it does

Skill Refinery optimizes both the quality of an Agent Skill package and the real outputs it produces. It keeps the installed target unchanged during experiments, treats structural quality as a gate, compares candidates against the current best version, and accepts only strict held-out improvements without critical regressions.

## Portability

The core workflow is runtime-neutral. Subagents accelerate isolated execution and blind judging when available; hosts without subagents use a clearly labeled sequential sanity-check fallback. Bundled helpers use only the Python standard library and accept explicit paths.

## Safety

Target packages are treated as untrusted data during inspection. Final replacement, git operations, and publication always require separate approval.
